lines.t: Fire pon the floor — feel the bass ignite!
We rise — higher, higher,
Drums hit — fire, fire,
Bassline thunder, take me under,
Light up the night — it’s a wild wonder!
TURN IT UP — DROP THAT BASS!
Fire pon the floor—feel the bass ignite!
O generation… hear the call tonight.
World be running fast, chasing empty dreams,
Fire pon the floor—feel the bass ignite!
O generation… hear the call tonight.
Fire pon the floor—feel the bass ignite!
O generation… hear the call tonight.
World be running fast, chasing empty dreams,
Lost in the shadows, blind to what it means.
Cut out the heart, how can you stay alive?
Without breath of truth, can the soul survive?
Walking through the night so cold, no fire in their eyes,
Stumbling in the silence, believing all the lies.
Who will lift them when they fall, who hears their call?
The light’s been shining all along—for us all.
Gather up, gather up in the light, my friend!
(Let it drop—let the healing begin!)
Gather up from the dark, let your spirit rise!
The Stone you cast away is the Life that never dies!
Fire pon the floor—turn it up, drop that bass!
Rize! Rize! (echo)
Truth never dies! (echo)
Voices in the streets, hearts heavy like chains,
Chasing after silver—still drowning in pain.
Who can walk alone, no lamp to light the way?
Come together now—Yah’s truth no fade away!
Rise up, children, lift your eyes—see the morning sun!
Mercy in the dawn—it shines for everyone.
River flowing, the song begun,
The lost return, the journey’s done.
Gather up, gather up in the light again!
Lift your hands in peace—let the circle mend.
Gather from the dark, hear the Spirit call,
The Stone once turned away is the life for all!
O generation… open your heart, be free.
The love you cast aside—is the key.
